candidate_decisions.reason: The supplied channel nomination has a coherent pericope-local relation: the focus request for nearer rashad contacts the prepared-heart, proof, guidance, deviation, readiness, and sound-course carriers supplied at 18:10, 18:14-15, and 18:17. Every nominated branch has an exact focus or context carrier and a focus return.

The legacy HFT trace supplies exact 18:10 coordinates for Lordship, preparation, and the affair, plus the focus rashad return. Its attributed relation is independently grounded and changes the focus from a generic request for a nearer position to renewed preparation of an unsettled affair.

The trace lands increase at 18:13, divine guiding and deviation at 18:17, and the focus comparative at 18:24. This supports an attributed incremental or replacement-route reading while preserving the live alternative that the comparison concerns destinations rather than stages.

The exact HFT trace connects the preparation at 18:16 with the ordered inspection, purity, subtlety, and exposure controls at 18:19, then returns through the focus rashad word. The resulting operational account of right guidance is materially distinct from an abstract route reading.

The trace names exact sheltering, directional deflection, passage, and open-space carriers at 18:16-17 and returns through the focus nearness and direction words. It supports a qualified geometric mode of guidance without replacing the ordinary petition.

The trace supplies reawakening and uncertain duration at 18:12 and 18:19, then lands forgetting and remembrance in the focus. The contact supports an attributed expansion from a momentary lapse to recovery of orientation after disrupted continuity.

The trace lands proliferating claims about the hidden at 18:22, premature tomorrow-speech at 18:23, the bounded focus utterance at 18:24, and the knowledge attribution at 18:26. The ordered contacts support a distinct speech-hinge reading with exact focus return.

The exploratory split-root nomination is independently anchored by the explicit fewness carrier at 18:22 and the focus q-l-l-mapped speech carrier at 18:24. It is retained as an economy-of-speech resonance only, with the supplied containment that it is not the lexical translation of qul.

The exploratory material branch for hope after cessation is tied to the focus asya, forgetting, and the supplied awakening-after-suspension carrier at 18:12. It survives as a qualified interruption-return analogy rather than as the ordinary lexical gloss.

findings.title: Prepared hearts and a sound course
findings.claim: Within the cave pericope, the focus request for a nearer rashad can be heard as the next movement of a prepared response: a heart is steadied, false or deviant claims are tested, and an unsettled affair is made ready for a sound course.
findings.mechanism: Context carriers for fastening the heart, inward steadiness, compelling proof, deviation, readiness, and guidance meet the focus carriers for divine guidance and rashad. Their contact turns the focus comparative into a request for a sound course that has been prepared through vulnerability and examination.
findings.reader_payoff: The request for nearer rightness becomes an actionable pericope-local movement from a vulnerable interior state toward a course that can actually be followed.
findings.containment: The ordinary exception, remembrance command, and petition remain intact. This finding records a trusted channel nomination and its supplied contacts as a local contextual resonance; it does not claim an exhaustive surah-wide system or make the resonance the sole meaning.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted and every branch has a supplied carrier, but the integrated relation is still an authored contextual synthesis over nominated branch images.

Their contact makes nearness a possible further increment or replacement route while keeping divine guidance as the enabling act.

findings.containment: The legacy-unbound trace leaves open whether the comparison concerns stages or destinations. The ordinary request for guidance remains primary, and no fixed progression is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The supplied HFT coordinates and focus returns are exact, while the incremental synthesis is explicitly marked as reader inference and legacy-unbound.

findings.title: From assertive speech to bounded petition
findings.claim: In the immediate pericope sequence, 18:24 turns repeated claims about the hidden and confident speech about tomorrow into a bounded speech act: condition action on divine willing, repair forgetting, ask for nearer rightness, and leave inaccessible knowledge with God.
findings.mechanism: The 18:22 carriers for circulating sayings, hiddenness, and sharp dispute meet the 18:23 future horizon, the focus speech imperative, and the 18:26 knowledge attribution. The focus therefore functions as a hinge between proliferating assertion and petitionary speech that acknowledges a limit.
findings.reader_payoff: The exception at the opening and the remembrance and hope commands become one disciplined way of speaking when human control over future action and hidden knowledge is limited.
findings.containment: The adjacent speech acts may also be read as separate topic-specific commands; the hinge is retained as a qualified pericope inference. The ordinary exception and prayer remain intact.

epistemic.reason: The sequence and all HFT coordinates are supplied, but the claim that 18:24 is their hinge is explicitly reader inference from a legacy-unbound trace.

findings.title: A deliberately small utterance
findings.claim: Against the repeated public sayings of 18:22, the focus command to say can be heard through the supplied split-root nomination as a deliberately small, bounded utterance that reduces rather than multiplies assertion.
findings.mechanism: The focus q-l-l-mapped speech carrier contacts the explicit q-l-l fewness carrier in 18:22 and the circulating-speech carrier there. The contact changes the response from merely saying a formula into making the speech itself economical.
findings.reader_payoff: The short corrective utterance becomes perceptible as a reduction in the scale of claim-making after public speculation has proliferated.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory split-root resonance. It is not the lexical translation of qul, does not alter the ordinary imperative, and remains tied to the explicit fewness and circulating-speech context.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record is legacy-unbound and explicitly marks the q-w-l to q-l-l relation as a split mapping; the independent fewness carrier and focus return keep it visible but exploratory.

findings.title: Hope after an interruption
findings.claim: The focus's hope operator can be heard, through the supplied material branch, as holding open renewed guidance after memory or awareness has gone offline: an interruption need not be final.
findings.mechanism: The focus asya carrier is linked to the supplied image of milk returning after cessation, while forgetting and the 18:12 awakening carrier provide the interruption and resumption contacts. The material image gives petitionary hope a form of renewed availability.
findings.reader_payoff: The hope in the final petition becomes more than softened certainty: it leaves room for guidance to return after a real break in continuity.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory interruption-return analogy, not the ordinary lexical translation of asya and not a claim that the focus concerns animals or milk. The narrower modal reading remains live.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record is legacy-unbound and marks the material branch as surprising, but its exact focus and contextual carriers satisfy the attributed activation trace.

findings.title: Nearer than the straight path
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:6-1:7 members give the focus request for nearer rashad a specific overlay: after a prayer naming the straight path and its contrasting straying, nearer guidance can be heard as a refinement of a path relation already made explicit.
findings.mechanism: The focus hidayah carrier returns through the exact external guidance and straight-path occurrences in 1:6, while the 1:7 straying occurrence supplies the contrasting boundary. This contact adds the path-shaped comparative frame without changing the focus's ordinary request.
findings.reader_payoff: The word nearer gains a concrete baseline: the petition can seek a more fitting relation to a named straight course rather than an unspecified new destination.
findings.containment: This is a phase-two external overlay only. It uses 1:6 and 1:7 as individually cited members, does not import a whole-surah thesis, and does not replace the native pericope readings. The remaining added Fatiha members supply no separately landed delta here.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and exact external word/root occurrences are supplied, but the lean external projection has no separate branch lexicon, connection record, or trust label.
